newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were higher in late trading on Wednesday on the back of tight supply, traders said.

March SIR20 were quoted at 54.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, Surabaya and Palembang against last week's levels of 53.75-54.00 U.S. cents/lb. In Padang, offer prices rose 0.75 cents to 54.25 U.S. cents/lb.

"The market lacks of raw material because many farmers haven't returned to work after celebrating the Eid al-Fitr," said one trader. Traders said March SIR20 was also higher in Pontianak and Jambi at 53.875 U.S. cents/lb against 53.25 U.S.
Traders said no fresh deals were heard on Wednesday, but said enquiries came from Europe and the United States.

"Prices are still too high and buyers may enter the market next week when levels ease down," said one trader. "There are people who put an offer of 55.00 U.S. cents/lb, but I think that's not logical. I believe deals will be done when prices reach between 53.00 and 54.00," he added.

Traders said the market still lacked of foreign factors which could lead to any further movement. During the Eid al-Fir celebrations, Indonesians usually return to their hometown, but they go back to work a week after the festivity ends.
